exposure: Fetal presentation (frank breech vs. incomplete/complete breech)
outcome: cesarean sections due to cord prolapses
cohort: 1168 women at term with a singleton in breech presentation intending vaginal birth between January 2004 and December 2018
finding: There were no differences in cesarean section rates or short-term fetal morbidity between births out of frank breech position and those out of incomplete/complete breech presentation.
mod_finding: The need for manual assistance during vaginal birth was significantly more frequent in deliveries of infants in incomplete/complete breech presentation compared to frank breech presentation.
